title: David Tepper still feels Bryce Young can win multiple Super Bowls, in the right situation

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: David Tepper still feels Bryce Young can win multiple Super Bowls, in the right situation
sources.description: When the Panthers traded up to select Bryce Young at No. 1 overall in the 2023 draft, team owner David Tepper noted that the club felt like Young gave Carolina the best chance to win Super Bowls — with an emphasis on the plural.
